groupPermissions.description: The bsvOS shell: wallet, policy console, approvals, messaging, app store and work boards. This is the operator surface — the same trust level as the bsv CLI and the old Quickshell panel, not a sandboxed third-party app. Every spend still goes through the daemon's policy engine and is recorded with an audit trail.

spendingAuthorization.description: operator surface — spends are policy-gated by the daemon, this manifest grants no blanket cap
